source_school: Harvard College Dean of Students Office Staff
bio: I manage student records, maintain the letter of recommendation dossier service for Currier House, liaise with various offices at the college as well as other Houses, prepare paperwork for the Administrative Board, answer questions regarding requirements, and send email reminders about various deadlines. I enjoy sending out the weekly newsletter for the House. I run reports through My.Harvard, keep and maintain data with Excel, design invitations and posters with Microsoft Publisher, write the house newsletter, proofread and copy edit announcements, redact sensitive material, and compose letters for student visas and to confirm academic standing. I moved to the Boston area in 2011 after attending the Clarion Science Fiction and Fantasy Writing Workshop at UC San Diego. I enjoy theater, museums, reading, writing, podcasts, science fiction conventions, yoga, jogging, drawing, volunteering for political campaigns, and talking about my cat. I began to work for Harvard University in December 2016 as a temporary employee. This includes work at Harvard T.H. Chan School of Public Health, Harvard Law School Alumni Center, and the Harvard Kennedy School of Government. I started working at Currier House in August 2018.
